pr_comments:
CI minimal failure is relevant, but I don't know how to properly deal with it. The failing test takes the output of `-cipher-commands` and plans tests according to it. 

It can either be fixed either via updating via apps/progs.pl or hard-coding.

> The failing test takes the output of -cipher-commands and plans tests according to it.

Can we rewrite the test to not use `-cipher-commands`, e.g. use `-cipher-algorithms` instead? We shouldn't be using deprecated stuff in our tests.

> Can we rewrite the test to not use `-cipher-commands`, e.g. use `-cipher-algorithms` instead? We shouldn't be using deprecated stuff in our tests.

The `-cipher-algorithms` is not equivalent option. In fact, there is no strictly equivalent option.

May be we should not deprecate these options and just add the checks for presence of the algorithms?

> May be we should not deprecate these options and just add the checks for presence of the algorithms?

Hmm. I'm not keen on that. We really don't want to have this hard coded list for any longer than we have to.
Ok. I have some ideas how to eliminate the command from tests and hopefully will be able to do it
My suggestion would be to condition that test out in a deprecated build.  I don't think it is a relevant test anymore -- it was created as a sanity check.
This pull request is ready to merge

issue_context.title: list -cipher-commands lists ciphers that aren't available
issue_context.body: The list option `-cipher-commands` option is supposed to list the available ciphers. However it takes no note of what providers are available so, for example, if the  legacy provider is not loaded it will still list legacy ciphers.
comments:
> if the legacy provider is not loaded it will still list legacy ciphers.

Well, er, yes.  Those are not from the legacy provider, they are EVP_PKEY_METHOD implementations.
(we do confuse legacy and legacy...)

I assume this will be resolved as soon as we start clearing `standard_methods[]` (in `crypto/evp/pmeth_lib.c`)

> I assume this will be resolved as soon as we start clearing standard_methods[] (in crypto/evp/pmeth_lib.c)

As I read the code its just a hard coded list:

https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/b03da688a223c18b5a10b5a66abe229bbb590133/apps/progs.pl#L176-L218
Oh *cipher* commands.... Never mind, I read this wrong.
I think you should deprecate the idea of "cipher-name is a command" and not add any more because of the complexity of handling providers.

This should list available ciphers, rather than a fixed list.  `-cipher-algorithms` does this.

Keep the fixed list.  Attempt to fetch each item in the list and only print it if it is found.
Deprecate the option.

Ditto for `-digest-commands`

review_comments: Should we print a warning about this command being deprecated if someone tries to use it?. Probably there also needs to be some documentation updates too - as well as CHANGES. In CHANGES, doc and any warning message we should make sure we should point the user at what they should use instead.
I've updated the man page and CHANGES.md. I can add the warning message either, but it's absent for `-engine` option.
IMO if people aren't told that something is deprecated when they attempt to use it, then its not really deprecated.
